Thin spots

No place here carries vietnamese-american owned, chinese-american owned, korean-american owned, mexican-american owned, greek-american owned, black-owned, woman-owned, cake and yeast, both, raised only, cake only, fried overnight, fries again midday, tamales, open before 5 a.m., closes when sold out, cash only, closed. That says nothing about America’s donut counters — it says where the reading stopped. What would earn it: vietnamese-american owned — the owner's own words or a press profile naming the family; chinese-american owned — the owner's own words or a press profile naming the family; korean-american owned — the owner's own words or a press profile naming the family; mexican-american owned — the owner's own words or a press profile naming the family; greek-american owned — the owner's own words or a press profile naming the family; black-owned — the owner's own statement, a press profile naming the owner, a Black-owned business directory; woman-owned — the owner's own statement, a press profile naming the owner, a women-owned business certification (WBENC, WOSB); cake and yeast, both — the menu, the shop's own words, or a press piece that names both; raised only — the menu or the shop's own words; cake only — the menu or the shop's own words; fried overnight — posted hours, the shop's own words, or a dated press piece; fries again midday — the shop's own words or a dated press piece; tamales — the menu or a press piece naming them; open before 5 a.m. — posted hours; closes when sold out — the shop's own site or a dated press piece; cash only — the shop's own site or a dated press piece; closed — a dated press piece or the shop's own notice. Thin so far: cambodian-american owned (2), lgbtq+ welcoming (1), cut by hand (1), drive-thru (2), pink box (1), counter or window, no tables (1). Every source read for this is listed on where all of this came from. A shop that wants a tag it has earned can say so on its own site or in a public directory, and it gets read there.

Reading the tags

👪 Family-runa press profile or the shop's own history
🇰🇭 Cambodian-American ownedthe owner's own words, a press profile naming the family, or an oral-history archive. Never a surname, never a guess.
🇻🇳 Vietnamese-American ownedthe owner's own words or a press profile naming the family
🥢 Chinese-American ownedthe owner's own words or a press profile naming the family
🇰🇷 Korean-American ownedthe owner's own words or a press profile naming the family
🇲🇽 Mexican-American ownedthe owner's own words or a press profile naming the family
☕ Greek-American ownedthe owner's own words or a press profile naming the family
✊🏾 Black-ownedthe owner's own statement, a press profile naming the owner, a Black-owned business directory
♀ Woman-ownedthe owner's own statement, a press profile naming the owner, a women-owned business certification (WBENC, WOSB)
🏳️‍🌈 LGBTQ+ welcomingthe business's own statement, a press list whose framing says the businesses in it are LGBTQ-owned, or a public directory (an LGBTQ chamber of commerce, a Pride business list, OpenStreetMap lgbtq=welcome)
🔄 Cake and yeast, boththe menu, the shop's own words, or a press piece that names both
🍩 Raised onlythe menu or the shop's own words
🧁 Cake onlythe menu or the shop's own words
✂ Cut by handthe shop's own words or a press piece describing the bench
🌙 Fried overnightposted hours, the shop's own words, or a dated press piece
🔁 Fries again middaythe shop's own words or a dated press piece
🥟 Egg rollsthe menu, a photograph of the case, or a press piece naming them
🌯 Breakfast burritosthe menu, a photograph of the board, or a press piece naming them
🥪 Deli or bodega sandwichesthe menu, a press piece naming the sandwich, or — for a harvested row — a shop that calls itself a deli or bodega in its own name. In New York that means a bacon egg and cheese on a kaiser roll; in California it usually means a donut-and-deli counter.
🌭 Kolaches and klobasnikythe menu or a press piece naming them
🥐 Croissant sandwichesthe menu or a photograph of the board
🍚 Fried rice or chow meinthe menu or a press piece naming it
🌽 Tamalesthe menu or a press piece naming them
🫓 Biscuits and gravythe menu or a press piece naming them
🧋 Boba or smoothiesthe menu or a photograph of the board
🍦 Ice creamthe menu
⏰ Open before 5 a.m.posted hours
🕓 Open around the clockposted hours
⏳ Closes when sold outthe shop's own site or a dated press piece
🚗 Drive-thruthe shop's own site, a press piece, or OpenStreetMap drive_through=yes
💵 Cash onlythe shop's own site or a dated press piece
🎁 Pink boxa photograph, the shop's own words, or a press piece naming the box
🪟 Counter or window, no tablesthe shop's own site, a press piece, or OpenStreetMap takeaway=only
⚫ Closeda dated press piece or the shop's own notice

Each tag names where it came from. No tag means we haven't read that one yet.
